### `setStatusCode` (inline helper)

`setStatusCode statusCode: string`

Override the response status (validated 100..599). Side effect; returns "". https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/templating/templating.html

**Kind:** inline helper · **Arity:** 1 argument(s) · **Source:** Hoverfly helper

Example: `{{setStatusCode '404'}}`
